metadata.title: Email Collaboration Relay Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines the architectural capability for group-bounded, collaborative email communication among institution-associated participants. This pattern represents stable architectural intent and is distinct from secure institutional email, notification gateways, and bulk messaging.

components.title: Group-Bounded Email Collaboration
components.description: Provides moderated, group-scoped email communication to support collaboration among staff, faculty, and students across one or more institutions using institution-associated email identities.

links.text: Supports Communications Management (BC220) business capability in the Business Reference Model (BRM).
Maps to Email (TC048) in the Technology Reference Model (TRM).
Handles Communications and Correspondence (DE188) data entity in the Data Reference Model (DRM).

implemented-requirements.remarks: Participants in collaboration relays must be authenticated using institution-associated identities to ensure accountability and trust among group members.
Collaboration relays must retain audit records sufficient to support accountability and investigation of group communications.

components.remarks: This pattern applies to collaborative, group-bounded email relays with managed membership. It intentionally excludes bulk or campaign messaging, automated notification gateways, and general mailbox-based email services. Membership governance, review, and attestation are required but defined outside this pattern in operational and platform standards.
